name: ibis Yogyakarta Adi Sucipto
short_description: An eco-certified economy hotel on Jalan Laksda Adi Sucipto near the airport, with a 5.0/5 ALL rating from 291 reviews as of research.
ai_summary: ibis Yogyakarta Adi Sucipto sits on Jalan Laksda Adi Sucipto in Sleman, close to the airport, a shopping mall (a 5-minute walk), and Yogyakarta's main tourist sights within about 25 minutes. The eco-certified hotel offers all-you-can-eat breakfast at Ibis Kitchen Wok, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and a gym, spa and meeting rooms, and its official ALL page shows a striking 5.0/5 customer rating from 291 reviews as of the research date.

core_facts.address: Jalan Laksda Adi Sucipto No 80, Sleman, 55221 Yogyakarta, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 5.0/5 customer review rating from 291 reviews on the official ALL booking page as of research
All-you-can-eat breakfast and meals at Ibis Kitchen Wok
5-minute walk to the nearest shopping mall with a cinema
On-site gym, spa and meeting rooms plus free high-speed Wi-Fi
cons: About 25 minutes from Malioboro, Vredeburg, Taman Sari, the Sultan's Palace and Beringharjo market -- not walkable to the city's main heritage sights
Economy-tier room format typical of the ibis brand
research_highlights: A 5.0/5 rating across 291 reviews on the official ALL page is unusually high for a budget-tier property
Located on the same Jalan Laksda Adi Sucipto strip as Grand Mercure Yogyakarta Adi Sucipto, making it a convenient airport-area cluster
research_watchouts: The airport-area location means a 20-30 minute trip to reach central Yogyakarta's main heritage sights

faqs.question: Is ibis Yogyakarta Adi Sucipto close to the airport?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits on Jalan Laksda Adi Sucipto in Sleman, close to Yogyakarta's airport, with central sights like Malioboro around 25 minutes away.
